summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the conclusion of its on-market share buy-back, repurchasing 911,200 ordinary shares (US$0.50 each) on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on 28 September 2026 at HK$158.00–HK$160.70, volume-weighted average HK$159.5951, executed by BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC. Since commencement on 5 August 2026, HSBC repurchased 31,735,502 shares on UK venues at 15.1909 and 16,921,600 on HKEX at HK$161.2887, totaling approximately US$1bn, all for cancellation. Issued ordinary capital and total voting rights stand at 17,141,942,291 shares, with no treasury shares held.
